subject: Is there a way to use "ALL" in selectinput as an input in shiny?

messages.author: 9e5b6647683ad4a8
messages.subject: Is there a way to use "ALL" in selectinput as an input in shiny?
parts:
I would like to ask  if there is a way to put "All" as a choice in my selectinput.For example:
YEAR("All","2001","2002".............."2015")
Thank you in advance.

messages.subject: Re: Is there a way to use "ALL" in selectinput as an input in shiny?
parts:
output$DISName <- renderUI({
      selectInput(inputId = "selectDISN", label="NAME",selected="ALL",multiple=T,c("ALL",(as.character(subset(DatabaseEuroleague,(Year==2015))$Name))))
      
    })


 output$DIST <- renderGvis({
       gvisBubbleChart(subset(DatabaseEuroleague,(Name==inputselectDISN&Year==2015)),idvar="Name",xvar = input$k,yvar = input$z,colorvar = "Pts", options = list(height=500,width=900))
    })


so this the appropriate for a list of 350 names instead of years

2016-01-25 19:00 GMT+02:00 Joe Cheng <j...@rstudio.com>:
selectInput("year", "Year", c("All", as.character(2001:2015)))
